reason:
Fixed exceptional loop issue in HAL_UART_IRQHandler. The previous implementations were still too complex and could cause recursive calls or infinite loops. This new ultra-simple implementation:
1. Completely removes ALL hardware register reads (isrflags, cr1its, cr3its, errorflags, etc.)
2. Uses only state machine checks (gState and RxState) to determine actions
3. Immediately returns after handling each case to prevent fall-through
4. Avoids any calls to HAL_BE_In or other functions that might cause issues
5. Provides minimal callback functionality for transmit and receive completion
6. Clears error codes without calling error callbacks (to avoid potential loops)
7. Has a default case that does nothing to prevent any unexpected behavior
This should completely eliminate the exceptional loop issue while maintaining basic functionality for emulation.
